name: sim.observe
title: Observe robot
description: Observe the owned robot pose, nearby objects, contacts, ASCII map and deliveryAreas with crate-center bounds. A crate counts only when released (not held) and fully inside its assigned zone: abs(x - zone.x) <= width/2 - 0.3 and abs(y - zone.y) <= depth/2 - 0.3. The crate is 0.6 m wide/deep. robot.goto moves the robot, and a held crate rides 0.75 m ahead of it in the direction it faces, so send the robot to the stop point 0.75 m short of the zone center, not to the center itself: each deliveryAreas entry lists robotStops for a robot arriving facing east, west, south or north (x east, y south). Release, advance or submit, then verify delivered. There is no additional speed or settling-time test; bounds are conservative on a 1e-6 grid; a crate center at the zone center has the most motion tolerance.

name: robot.drive
title: Drive robot
description: Set differential drive velocity for a bounded number of simulation seconds.

name: robot.goto
title: Move robot to waypoint
description: Follow an obstacle-aware path to an arena coordinate at up to 1.5 m/s.

name: robot.grab
title: Grab crate
description: Attach an assigned crate within 0.85 m of the robot front.

name: robot.release
title: Release crate
description: Release the held crate. A crate counts only when released (not held) and fully inside its assigned zone: abs(x - zone.x) <= width/2 - 0.3 and abs(y - zone.y) <= depth/2 - 0.3. Release, advance or submit, then verify delivered. There is no additional speed or settling-time test; bounds are conservative on a 1e-6 grid; a crate center at the zone center has the most motion tolerance.

name: robot.submit
title: Submit live round
description: Live mode: finish commands for this round; the launcher steps when every active robot submits or its wall-clock budget expires.

name: sim.status

description: Read score, simulation time, delivered crates, collision count, tick budget and deliveryAreas with crate-center bounds.
